title: See who's playing, and a guide for your first days

changes.text: The front page now shows what players did in the last 24 hours: trades, blackjack hands, card pulls and prediction bets, the newest of each with who did it and when, and a countdown to the next order batch. When it's quiet, it says so.

New accounts get a Your first days card on the front page and their profile: pick your oshi, buy your first shares, hold through a tick, hold through Saturday's Dividend Review, and claim your 5 free cards. Each step ticks itself off when you've done it, and you can hide it any time.
Your position on a stock's page now shows what selling it all right now would bring after the fee, and your profit or loss. How to play has a new answer: When should I sell?
While you're new, the fill card after a buy explains what happens next: what the shares are worth, when the next tick lands, and what Saturday's review does.
